_doc: Culinary-to-Federal crosswalk: Cost Index ingredient slugs -> US Census HS6 import commodity codes. Every code is VERIFIED against the Census I_COMMODITY_SDESC returned in data/census-imports.jsonl (the description must match the ingredient). US Census general-imports data is public domain. HS6 is the finest public aggregation; some codes combine related items or a single form (fresh/frozen) — noted. This is a descriptive reference of the US import stream — never a delivered/retail price, never import VOLUME (quantity is not published at HS6), never a forecast.
_source: US Census Bureau, International Trade, general imports by HS6 (api.census.gov/data/timeseries/intltrade/imports/hs). Public domain.

030221.sdesc: HALIBUT/GREENLAND TURBOT EX FILLET, LVR, ROE FR/CH

070310.note: HS6 combines onions and shallots; not split by color/variety.

070410.sdesc: CAULIFLOWERS AND BROCCOLI, FRESH OR CHILLED
070410.note: HS6 combines cauliflower and broccoli; not split.

070490.note: The 'other brassicas' basket (cabbages, kale, kohlrabi, Chinese cabbage); broader than any single item.

070511.sdesc: HEAD LETTUCE (CABBAGE LETTUCE), FRESH OR CHILLED

070519.sdesc: LETTUCE, EXCEPT HEAD LETTUCE, FRESH OR CHILLED
070519.note: Leaf and romaine lettuces, combined (all lettuce except head).

070610.sdesc: CARROTS AND TURNIPS, FRESH OR CHILLED

070820.sdesc: BEANS (VIGNA SPP., PHASEOLUS SPP.) FRESH OR CHILLD
070820.note: Fresh leguminous beans (Vigna/Phaseolus) — green/snap beans and relatives.

070940.sdesc: CELERY OTHER THAN CELERIAC, FRESH OR CHILLED

070951.sdesc: MUSHROOMS OF THE GENUS AGARICUS, FRESH OR CHILLED

070993.sdesc: PUMPKINS, SQUASH AND GOURDS, FRESH OR CHILLED
070993.note: Fresh Cucurbita (squash/zucchini/pumpkin/gourds); not split by variety; data 2012+.

080719.note: HS6 combines other melons (cantaloupe/honeydew) and papayas; broader than cantaloupe alone.

070190.sdesc: POTATOES, EXCEPT SEED, FRESH OR CHILLED, NESOI
070190.note: Fresh table potatoes; not split by variety.

071420.sdesc: SWEET POTATOES, FRESH OR DRIED, WHETHER/NT PELLETS

040690.sdesc: CHEESE, NESOI, INCLUDING CHEDDAR AND COLBY
040690.note: The 'other cheese' basket, explicitly including cheddar and colby; broader than cheddar alone.

040721.note: Fresh chicken eggs in shell (NESOI); data 2012+.

020230.sdesc: MEAT OF BOVINE ANIMALS, BONELESS, FROZEN
020230.note: Frozen boneless beef — the US import stream here is largely lean manufacturing trim that feeds grinding; HS6 does not isolate a retail cut, so only ground-beef is attached, never the whole-muscle steaks.

020329.note: Frozen pork cuts (NESOI); HS6 does not split by cut, so this one shared stream describes all three pork cuts as supply context.

_pending.resolved_2026_07: whole-salmon (030214), whole-halibut (030221) and whole-trout (030211) are now mapped and SDESC-verified.
_pending.captured_not_tracked: mussels — SDESC-verified US import streams were pulled for both forms (030731 live/fresh, 030732 frozen) and kept in data/census-imports.jsonl for provenance, but mussels is not one of the 100 tracked ingredients, so no slug is attached; add a mapping only if mussels is ever added as a tracked ingredient (it needs its own yield/pricing spine too).
_pending.deliberately_unmapped: Left without an import code on purpose after an SDESC probe: the individual fresh herbs (basil, cilantro, parsley, dill, mint, oregano, rosemary, tarragon, thyme) and okra fall only under the catch-all 070999 'vegetables fresh NESOI' basket (~$0.45B, not isolable at HS6); the premium beef steaks (ribeye, striploin, beef-tenderloin, short-rib) plus chicken and turkey are domestic-dominant and HS6 does not isolate the cut, so their import streams would misrepresent the item; vegetable-oil is a blend with no single HS6; fresh sweet corn / corn-on-the-cob returned no usable HS6 series. Absence here is a deliberate honesty choice, not missing work.
_pending.note: The import field is populated only for ingredients with a genuine, SDESC-verified US import stream. Where HS6 combines several tracked items under one code (peppers, lettuces, brassicas, squash, pork cuts...), the shared stream is attached to each with a 'combines / not split' note — descriptive supply context, never a per-item delivered price or volume.
